+    /*
+     * Price changes are audited downstream. Body: { "priceCents": 1299; "reason": "promo" }
+     */
+    @PatchMapping("/{id}/price")
+    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'PRICING')")
+    public ResponseEntity<ProductResponse> updatePrice(
+            @PathVariable final Long id,
+            @Valid @RequestBody final PriceChangeRequest request) {
+        if (request.priceCents() <= 0) {
+            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();
+        }
+        return ResponseEntity.ok(productService.changePrice(id, request.priceCents(), request.reason()));
+    }
